title: Build typed tool registry, proposal validation, and structured observations
verify: Unknown tools and invalid arguments produce structured observations.
Every tool/action proposal receives exactly one observation.
evidence_required: Unit tests for strict schema validation, unknown properties rejection, unknown tool handling, and bounded observation output.
Security tests for no hidden reasoning, raw provider output, secrets, auth material, or oversized blobs in observations.
constraints: Tools are narrow domain contracts with typed input/output schemas, risk class, side-effect class, scope, timeout, result limits, retry policy, and audit policy.
Forbidden broad tools include execute_anything, unrestricted SQL writes, arbitrary API caller, direct external send, direct physical actuation, and hidden provider memory tools.
invariants: Schema adherence is reliability but not security; local validation and permission checks still happen.
Tool results are bounded structured observations with refs for large artifacts.
verification_targets: Unknown tool, invalid args, malformed result, bounded observation, and result redaction evals.
